initial.name: Golden Gate Tap Room
initial.summary: More than 20 screens, a huge beer list, and enough games to keep eight grown men occupied.
initial.imageAlt: Crowded sports bar with numerous televisions inside Golden Gate Tap Room

initial.name: Johnny Foley’s
initial.summary: Guinness, Irish whiskey, honest pub food, and live entertainment. A strong first-night candidate.
initial.imageAlt: Guests seated at the ornate wooden bar inside Johnny Foley’s Irish House

initial.name: Bartlett Hall
initial.summary: House-brewed beer, pub food, and communal tables a few steps from the hotel.
initial.imageAlt: Guests gathered at communal tables beside the brewing tanks at Bartlett Hall

bench.name: The Barnes Restaurant + Bar
bench.summary: Cocktails, shareable plates, and absolutely no argument over whose turn it is to navigate.
bench.imageAlt: Illuminated bar and lounge seating inside The Barnes

bench.name: Local Edition
bench.summary: A newspaper-themed underground cocktail bar with live music and plenty of room for walk-ins.
bench.imageAlt: Wide view of the underground bar and lounge at Local Edition

bench.name: Tempest
bench.summary: Unpretentious SoMa dive-bar energy, rotating taps, strong drinks, and comfort food.
bench.imageAlt: A lively crowd inside the brick-walled Tempest bar

walkableBars.voteNote: Votes are shared live across everyone’s phones. All options stay visible and automatically sort by group preference.

taglines: Eight brothers. One city. Countless stories.
Good friends. Good beer. Great stories.
Meet up. Look around. Raise a glass.

hotel.name: The Barnes San Francisco
hotel.summary: Our home base in the middle of the city — a natural launch point for the reunion, sightseeing, restaurants, and nearby bars.
highlights: Three rooms reserved for the group
Easy access to cable cars and city sightseeing

reunion.title: The brotherhood reconvenes
reunion.summary: Wednesday is about getting everybody into town, gathering at SFO and The Barnes, and easing into San Francisco together.
reunion.closing: By late afternoon, everyone should be together at the hotel and ready for the first drink, dinner, and stories.

adventures.title: See the city from the top deck
adventures.name: Hop-On, Hop-Off San Francisco
adventures.summary: Our first full day is a flexible ride through San Francisco’s landmarks and neighborhoods. We can take in the big views, jump off where the group wants, and use the bus as our introduction to the city.
adventures.imageAlt: San Francisco cable car and city sightseeing scene

adventures.title: The big Bay Area day
adventures.name: Alcatraz, Muir Woods & Sausalito
adventures.summary: Rob has lined up the signature day of the trip: the history of Alcatraz, a walk among the redwoods, and time along the Sausalito waterfront — all in one memorable outing.

tourHighlights.name: Alcatraz
tourHighlights.text: A ferry across the Bay and a close look at one of America’s most famous historic sites.

tourHighlights.name: Muir Woods
tourHighlights.text: A change of pace beneath towering coastal redwoods just beyond the city.
tourHighlights.alt: Looking up at redwoods in Muir Woods

tourHighlights.name: Sausalito
tourHighlights.text: Waterfront views, shops, food, and a relaxed finish on the north side of the Bay.
tourHighlights.alt: Sausalito waterfront viewed from San Francisco Bay

restaurants.name: John’s Grill
restaurants.summary: An old-school downtown dining room known for steaks, seafood, cocktails, and its Maltese Falcon history.

restaurants.name: Sears Fine Food
restaurants.summary: A Union Square institution and an easy group breakfast option, especially for pancakes and classic morning fare.

restaurants.name: Fino Bar & Ristorante
restaurants.summary: A comfortable neighborhood-style Italian choice for pasta, seafood, wine, and an unhurried group dinner.

restaurants.name: Kin Khao
restaurants.summary: A lively nearby option for bold Thai food when the group wants something more distinctive than standard hotel-district fare.

restaurants.name: Pinecrest Diner
restaurants.summary: A straightforward diner close to the hotel for breakfast, burgers, or the moment somebody decides he still needs food.

restaurants.name: The Barnes Restaurant + Bar
restaurants.summary: The easy fallback for cocktails, shareable appetizers, or a meal when nobody feels like organizing another movement.
